source_description_html:
The Wildcat 12L Backpack was designed to be ultra-comfortable and adaptable, featuring a 3-liter / 100oz Hydrapak water reservoir with insulated hydration hoses. The Wildcat Tech adjustable shoulder straps offer 5-position options, fine-tuning the fit for a custom-tailored feel that accommodates riders of different sizes and gear.

Worn over a jersey, external armor, or a large ADV jacket, the ergonomics of the Wildcat Packs will evenly distribute the weight of the 3L reservoir, tools, and your essentials while avoiding pressure points and sore shoulders. The molded back panel and adjustable/removable sternum strap provide maximum comfort and support for riding rough terrain in the backcountry.

source_description_html:
The Basilisk IR Jacket is our waterproof enduro-touring kit. This jacket specializes in a balance of breathability, mobility, and protection, with a CE A-rating for abrasion / slide protection, and CE level-2 rating for impact protection with removable RHEON™ armor pads. 

The Basilisk IR Jacket combines high-performance premium materials with minimalist design, and packs smaller than a traditional ADV jacket for stashing on your bike when things get hot.

This latest version for 2025 features refined construction to improve water resistance, updated YKK® Aquaguard PU-coated zippers on vents and pockets, refined forearm adjuster position, and comes in new Red Rust, Olive Night, and Dark Onyx color options.

FEATURES
  • RHEON™ LABS armor: central back pad, shoulders, and elbows (Type A)
  • CE-A rated for abrasion and CE-Level 2 rated for impact protection (Pending)
  • 30k/10k with 0.06 cfm air permeability
  • Articulated anatomical fit
  • Fully taped construction with 20 mm seam taping
  • Reflective logos
  • Four pockets (two internal, two external)
  • Six mesh lined vents with flow-through venting
  • Cohaesive® embedded hem and collar adjustment
  • Draft skirt internal weather seal with silicone gripper elastic
  • Anti-flap torso adjustment
  • Gusseted adjustable hook and loop closure cuffs
  • High-performance DWR (Durable Water Repellent)
  • Weight of garment: 4.8lbs /2.18kg (size L, with armor pads), 3.3lbs / 1.5kg (size L with armor removed)
  • Ethically produced in China
MATERIALS

 

  • 3-Layer eVent fabric with Direct Venting™ Expedition technology
  • 100% Nylon 70d x 160d rip-stop face fabric, with 20d nylon tricot backer, 219g/sqm
  • Double-layer Super Fabric® 600d polyester with ceramic plating abrasion panels on elbows, shoulders, and back
  • Ax suede synthetic suede collar lining and chin guard
  • YKK Aquaguard® Vislon® zippers
  • YKK® Aquaguard PU-coated zippers
  • High-performance C0 DWR (Durable Water Repellent)
SPECS

Weight of garment: 4.8lbs /2.18kg (size L, with armor pads), 3.3lbs / 1.5kg (size L with armor removed)
